subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The mountain range looked** __non-intimidating__ **from afar, but the experienced climbers were undaunted by the challenge.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Formidable**."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'non-intimidating'** means not causing fear or anxiety. (डर या चिंता पैदा नहीं कर रहा)

 
 
• **Example**: *The gym owners tried to provide a friendly,** non-intimidating**__ environment for its members.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **'non-intimidating'** would be** 'formidable.'**
 
• 'Formidable' means inspiring fear. (डर पैदा करने वाला)
 __
 
• **Example**: *His mother is a rather **formidable**__ lady.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Poised** means composed or balanced. (किसी हरकत के लिए तैयार (परंतु वस्‍तुतः करना शेष))
 
• **Option 2: **Tranquil means peaceful or calm. (शांत, प्रशांत)
 
• **Option 4: Huge** means very large in size. (बहुत बड़ा, विशाल)
